# Think Green Design | Build Landscape

> Official AI-readable overview for Think Green Design | Build Landscape, a residential landscape design-build company serving Scottsdale, Phoenix, and nearby Arizona communities.

## What The Company Does
- Residential landscape design and build
- Hardscaping, patios, pavers, and retaining walls
- Outdoor kitchens, fire features, and outdoor lighting
- Desert-friendly landscaping, artificial turf, and irrigation upgrades
